meteorologicalExplanations: Overforecast areas are where AutoOutlook risk exceeds SPC. This usually means the HRRR/XGBoost fields are emphasizing local instability, shear, or hail/wind probabilities more aggressively than the human outlook. Feature-grid diagnostics were not available.

Underforecast areas are where SPC risk exceeds AutoOutlook. This usually points to missed large-scale forcing, storm coverage, or forecaster confidence signals that are not fully represented in the selected HRRR fields. Feature-grid diagnostics were not available.
summary.leakageGuard: Official SPC outlook and storm reports were fetched only after AutoOutlook prediction artifacts were generated.
